# C1 Coaching

> Elite football coaching for individual players and teams in Basildon, Essex, UK.

C1 Coaching provides professional 1:1 and group football coaching sessions for young players of all abilities. Founded and led by Head Coach Carl Morris, a former professional footballer, the business is based in Basildon, Essex and serves players across the surrounding area.

## Services

- **1:1 Football Coaching** — personalised one-to-one sessions tailored to the individual player's goals, skills and development needs
- **Group / Team Coaching** — high-intensity group sessions focused on teamwork, communication, and cohesion
- **Elite Performance Coaching** — advanced techniques for players looking to reach the highest level
- **Football Camps** — intensive holiday camp sessions for young players (details announced seasonally)

## Head Coach

**Carl Morris** — former professional footballer and founder of C1 Coaching. Carl designs every session individually, using encouragement, motivation, and reward to help young players build trust and perform at their best.
